remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946....No signature. On backing: In pencil by O'Keeffe, 'Abstraction of Stream'/1921/Georgia O'Keeffe" [obscured by Downtown Gallery label]. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 18, 19. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Abstraction of Stream

description: Vertical pastel in tones of orange, brown, rust, and ochre with touches of green and white.  As if an arial view of a stream with a winding dark line flowing up through the middle of the page and forking into two near the top.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
